summary: Planned how Westbourne reaches LPs for Fund III. Agreed a channel split between direct re-ups, a placement agent for continental Europe and direct new LP outreach, plus an 80-name target list. An Edinburgh LP day is pending and a gated website section was rejected.

discussion.keyPoints: Natalie handles most Fund II LPs. Richard has the senior relationships with the three largest. New LPs have no clear owner.
Westbourne has almost no reach into continental and Nordic LPs. Richard accepts a placement agent may be needed there but nowhere else.
Natalie wants a Westbourne LP day in Edinburgh to show the Scottish team. Richard was unsure about cost and timing.

recommendations.recommendation: Raise 50% through direct re-ups, 30% through a placement agent covering continental Europe and 20% through direct new LP outreach.
Approach 80 new LP targets with a goal of 25 first meetings by the end of Q1 2027.
Send prospective LPs a quarterly update letter before launch and follow up every first meeting within 6 weeks.
Host a Westbourne LP day in Edinburgh in March and attend two LP conferences.
Add a gated Fund III teaser section to the website.

actions.action: Assign a named relationship owner to each of the 80 new LP targets

nextFocus: Improve how LP first meetings and due diligence are run.
nextPreparation: Bring the last DDQ Westbourne answered and notes from recent LP meetings.

tests.question: What channel split did we agree for the raise?
How many new LPs are we approaching?
